mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_reschedule_command(id,command_namespace,actor_type,actor_id,authority_scope,request_id, canonical_version,payload_sha256,canonical_bytes,state,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{id},#{namespace},'USER',#{actor},#{scope},#{requestId},'canonical-v1',#{hash},#{canonical},'RESERVED',UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.select: SELECT id,canonical_version,payload_sha256,canonical_bytes,state,result_version,result_bytes FROM order_reschedule_command WHERE command_namespace=#{namespace} AND actor_type='USER' AND actor_id=#{actor} AND authority_scope=#{scope} AND request_id=#{requestId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE order_reschedule_command SET state='SUCCEEDED',result_version=1,result_bytes=#{result},updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND state='RESERVED'
mapper.select: SELECT service_duration_minutes FROM order_service_snapshot WHERE order_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
